steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Gah! The lift fell over––

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: If it had been a little lower, m-my leg would've...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I mean, hold on to my construct!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You idiot... Don't drag me down too! It's hard enough to stay afloat bringing you bunch with me!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: C-Captain... Thank you...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Next time, be smarter about how you run so you're less of a nuisance.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Watch out, Captain!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: That's... an artillery shell?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: No, it's far more destructive than normal artillery...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And, it was aimed so precisely at a small area?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Manfred... You've been watching us this whole time?!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Bloody hell, that slimy devil!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Alright, everyone stop right here! We don't need to chase after those Sarkaz. As for the driver...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: He's dead.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: This accursed place...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, wh-what is this...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: How can the city's defense artillery do this...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Londinium's wall defenses were built almost seventy years ago.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: This is the first time...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Their cannons have been aimed... inside the city.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Not too shabby.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Even 10% of its firepower is enough to melt ordinary structures.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So this is Londinium's ultimate defense.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: That was only an auxiliary cannon.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Our weapon experts have said the main guns are able to easily penetrate the armor of any high-speed warship.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A weapon expert...? Are you talking about the officer from the defense forces' engineering team?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I must thank you for capturing his wife and daughter.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Is he still alive?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As long as he is of use to the Sarkaz, he will not die.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Artilleryman, target Lift 11.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The shot went wide.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Unfortunate. We'll have to improve our accuracy.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: These cannons were meant to point outwards, after all.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Outwards... Before we entered Londinium, the defensive artillery was aimed at the ducal army outside the walls.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: When we entered the city under the guise of quelling the dukes' conflicts, they never even once thought to put us in their sights––

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Does that count as pointing outward?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Since the fall of Gaul and the silence of Iberia, a long time has passed without Victoria facing any real external threat.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Indeed, which is why His Majesty found this opportunity for us.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Such sophisticated weaponry should be put to greater use, rather than sitting here as ornaments adorning the doorway.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Artilleryman, activate dynamic target tracking.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Very good, it's working.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We had to spend nearly a whole month to calibrate them...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Luckily, they seem to be working well enough.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: These weapons put us in control of everything that enters and exits Londinium.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Once all our cannons are in place... There will be nowhere to hide under the shadow of these steel walls.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Dublinn seems to be drawing away the artillery fire.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Is this... a test run? Is their purpose really just to calibrate...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No, they're ultimately unconcerned with this port.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, what do we do now?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Continue to withdraw towards the city.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: However... the rest of Sudean is no longer safe.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The Sarkaz are tightening their grip on Londinium. As long as the city's artillery is pointed inwards, our lives are in their hands.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Unless...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: What's your plan, Lieutenant?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's nothing. Let's go, we'll talk after we've made our escape.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: These bloody walls! These bloody cannons!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, your constructs got destroyed again...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I don't... have time for this!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Don't just stand there staring! Away with you! Get out of here!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Forcing us to run, eh? Mark my words, Manfred, you insult me like this today, I swear I'll...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, that one I just saw running off that way... looked rather familiar...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The Lupo brunette? Is it her?!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Get her——

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Be careful, Captain!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What have you done?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I'm... protecting you... run! You still have to... find... for the Leader...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Fine... fine.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You're the thirteenth.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The thirteenth Taran life. I will mark you down in the Leader's place. One day, I will personally make the Sarkaz pay for each and every life.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, we've routed Dublinn's team.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I saw.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But we couldn't find the rebels... Those sly insects! They peeked their heads out for a moment, but they vanished again after we activated the cannons.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Uhh, could they have been killed already?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I... I don't think our job would be that easy.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'm glad you understand.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Then, did they blend into the crowd? Should we notify the patrol so they can detain the civilians and continue the search?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Continue to bombard the port. Oh, and increase the firepower.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Increase the firepower? The port is almost completely destroyed. I can't imagine anyone would be hiding there still.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They won't ever take this route again. Besides, have you ever seen a Sarkaz draw only half his sword?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Now that we've begun, why not let them see exactly what we're capable of?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're putting on a show of force for them. You want... to cut off their escape and force them to come out.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: This game of hide-and-seek has gone on long enough. Even if I don't mind waiting, the same cannot be said for His Majesty and the Royal Court.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Doesn't matter who it is. If they have a plan, I'd like them to hurry up with it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we don't have anywhere safe to hide!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if we all took cover under the structure, we'd still be...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Vulnerable to their artillery blowing us to bits!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I've done some rough calculations. If those cannons are fully charged, they'd be able to shoot clean through a standard city plate! This flimsy sheet plate above our heads on the wall there won't stand a chance!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Siege, Londinium's cannons here are serious business!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is the first time I've seen them fired off on such a scale.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That means they're rolling out the red carpet for us, right?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If that were the idea, we would be wiped out fifty kilometers outside the walls.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ahhh, I can't take it anymore––!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya, my drones can't reinforce these plates any further. At this rate, we're going to get blasted sky-high!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to get out of here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dublinn also scrambled to get away as fast as they could... but they used Arts constructs to defend themselves and left their wounded behind.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ugh... Argh, why's our luck so rotten...?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Are we going to die here?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We won't leave a single Londinier behind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Scout team, have you located the artillerymen?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not yet...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm afraid we can't find them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Londinium's urban defense cannons, and this wall looming in front of us, have always been a single entity.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In other words... we have no way of stopping the barrage if we can't scale the wall or get inside it?

options: Nobody can scale a wall under fire.
We couldn't find a way inside.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We can't just hide here waiting to die either!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Why don't I run out there and try to draw their fire? With my skills, I should be able to buy a few minutes...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Not happening.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: If you're not letting her do it alone, then let's all go.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Settle down, you two. Dagda, have you been hanging around Indra for so long that your brain turned to muscle?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: If it was as easy as getting some live bait out there, would the two of you still be here making a scene?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Our armor could maybe take two hits from a standard crossbow. Our friends in Engineering spent months working hard to make it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: If you're going to run out there and get yourself killed, you never should've come to Londinium in the first place!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Alright, I get it. But I swear, I'm not letting anything happen to Vina!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We... haven't even been home yet!

options: True, there's no point in running out there.
It's too early to be saying that kind of stuff.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor, do you have a plan?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Drones...? Hmm, hmm, I see... Oh, so that's where you're going with it. That makes sense.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What are you mumbling about now, Closure? The Doctor barely said two words, but you're acting like you had a whole conversation!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, my bad. I just got an idea.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Those cannons seem pretty intelligent, and at such a long range, they can't be completely manual. They must have some way of locking onto moving targets near the ground.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One or two guys running around won't be enough to get the cannons off our backs.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If I deploy all my drones at once, the targeting algorithm might see them as a higher-priority threat than us and the civilians, but...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But there's no guarantee?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well obviously, I can't promise anything!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Closure, the reinforcement failed. The pressure is too great for the drones to withstand!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The base plate is going to collapse within thirty seconds...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have no other choice. Let's give it a try.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On the Doctor's signal, all operators prepare to withdraw.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Five, four, three––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Two––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Drones, launching!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Run, everyone! Go, go!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did it work?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It bought us just enough time to move to a structure a few steps away... but this place won't last long either.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That was our one shot, too... My precious drones have all been reduced to scrap, and even I can't just conjure up another batch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't safely move forward or retreat backwards. If we want to escape the cannon fire, we're going to have to take some risks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I wish there were some way around all of this...
I heard you needed a guide?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who's there?!
Miss Cautus, I'd like to talk to you.
But before that, I'd appreciate it if you could have your people lower their weapons.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You–– Who are you?
Let's save the introductions for later.
Claws, a machete, and this... Uhh, this hammer? Ma'am, your weapon looks plenty brilliant, but I'd appreciate it if you could keep it away from my head.
Otherwise, this friend of yours might be in danger.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ––Doctor!!
Not too close now.
One more step, and your friend's head becomes a mess on the wall.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A-Amiya, the drone...!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One of the drones wrapped around when we weren't paying attention, and it's locked onto the Doctor's head!
You sure know your stuff, Miss Pointy-Ears.
To be honest, I'm getting more and more curious about you lot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All hands, weapons down.
There we go, that's nice. Oh, make sure you get the message to your snipers around the corner too. I bet they haven't blinked once since I showed up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do as he says.
Lovely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ––Sir.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope you believe us when we say that we'd never move to harm a stranger unprovoked, but––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Harm one thread on the Doctor's hood and I promise you, right here, right now, I don't need a weapon to ensure you never threaten another human being.
Ahem...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh... This place is already dangerous enough. Are we seriously going to get blown up before we even start our mission?!
Right, if we don't want the Sarkaz to turn us to dust, we don't have time to be pointing weapons at each others' heads.
Listen up, I have an idea. Please come with me, nice and easy.
I'm gonna keep borrowing your friend here until we get where we're going––
Sorry, but you don't get a say. Behave yourself and come along with me, my faceless friend.
